meta.title: Binance WebSocket Streaming Implementation
meta.for_claude: REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task.

overview.goal: Replace polling-based market data with real-time Binance Futures WebSocket streaming for orderbook, trades, and ticker updates.
overview.architecture: Create a new BinanceWsManager class that connects directly to Binance Futures WebSocket API (wss://fstream.binance.com). This replaces the current internal WsManager which connects to a non-functional backend WebSocket. The frontend will receive real-time depth updates (~100ms), trade events, and ticker changes directly from Binance.

background.current_problem: The existing WsManager connects to ws://localhost:4000 (internal ws-stream service), but this service only receives data from the OLD internal matching engine - NOT from Binance. Orderbook never updates in real-time, trades never stream, price only updates via slow REST polling (every 5 seconds).
background.solution: Connect the frontend directly to Binance Futures WebSocket API: wss://fstream.binance.com/stream?streams=<symbol>@depth@100ms/<symbol>@aggTrade/<symbol>@bookTicker

steps.description: Create a new singleton WebSocket manager that connects to Binance Futures WebSocket API
